source_scores.coverage: Matched frozen101, frozen104 and new count102 only; other75 previous candidates keep frozen source metrics without new scores.

definitions.pattern000: Known delayed rows with pattern 000 are common misses; pattern000 on-time or unknown rows are not called misses.
definitions.pattern111: Known delayed rows caught by all three models.
definitions.other_known_delayed: Caught by at least one frozen model. Counts only: the uncapped union is not evaluated as a new alert policy or reported as a new model recall.
definitions.budget: Complete closed daily floor(0.1*N), no carryover. Unknown outcomes compete before masks. No subgroup cap.
definitions.common_miss_rank: Per model: original full-day one-based rank, rank/N, and rank-floor(0.1*N). Closest is retrospective minimum across existing models, not a deployable selector.
definitions.interpretation: Descriptive reused-development evidence only. Counts conserve complete daily budgets; marginal groups overlap and do not establish feature causality or individual slot donor/recipient relationships.

closest_rank_views.interpretation: Retrospective minimum across the three existing full-day ranks for each common miss. It is neither a combined score nor a deployable policy; no union budget or oracle recall is evaluated.

policy.ranking: score DESC, raw score DESC (identical to score here), order_id ASC
policy.capacity_rule: floor(cap * complete daily batch rows); no carryover between days
policy.known_outcome_rule: Caller-supplied mask applied only after full-batch ranking
policy.allocation_rule: Within each day and route: within=min(dropped,added), outgoing=max(dropped-added,0), incoming=max(added-dropped,0). Sum outgoing equals sum incoming each day.
policy.interpretation: Aggregate daily count accounting only; no individual donor/recipient pairing and no causal feature attribution. Gross daily cross-route movements can cancel in monthly route net totals.

rank_movements.rank_rule: One-based rank divided by complete daily batch size; score DESC, order_id ASC.
rank_movements.notes: Full-batch ranks are computed before the known-outcome mask. Bins stay fixed at 10/20/50% even if cap differs from 10%.

notes: All three fixed model families and daily budgets remain unchanged. No model or selected artifact is deserialized.
Three evaluation months are repeatedly used development retests; the original retained test is not rescored.
Historical validation uses actual customer delivery strictly before each original cutoff. Repeated historical months across cutoffs are not pooled as independent samples.
All observed routes and declared empty bins are retained; common-miss and other-delay denominators partition each marginal.
Unknown labels never become delayed/on-time outcomes. Ranking and capacity always use the complete original day.
A minimum existing rank across models is only a hindsight description; no oracle selection, new blended scores, union policy or suitability claim is made.
